# Manchester Evening News

> Regional newspaper covering breaking news, sport, and community stories across Greater Manchester and surrounding areas.

Manchester Evening News is the primary news source for Greater Manchester, delivering live updates on local news, regional coverage, and sports reporting. The site covers major topics including community issues, employment, courts, and detailed coverage of Manchester United and Manchester City football clubs.

## Key Topics

- Greater Manchester
- Breaking News
- Local News
- Manchester United FC
- Manchester City FC
- Regional Coverage
- Community Stories
- Bolton
- Stockport
- Lancashire
- Court News
- Crime & Justice
- Employment & Worker Rights
- Saddleworth
- Match Reports

## Core News & Homepage

- [Manchester Evening News Homepage](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk): Homepage for Manchester Evening News regional newspaper covering Greater Manchester news
- [News - Live Updates & Breaking Stories](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/news): Main news section with live updates and breaking news from Greater Manchester region

## Football Coverage

- [Manchester United FC News Hub](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/all-about/manchester-united-fc): Manchester United FC news hub with transfers, fixtures, match reports and team updates
- [Manchester City FC News Hub](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/all-about/manchester-city-fc): Manchester City FC news hub covering transfers, fixtures, matches and squad information

## Regional & Local News Hubs

- [Lancashire News](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/all-about/lancashire): Lancashire regional news coverage including breaking news and community stories
- [Bolton News & Events](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/all-about/bolton): Bolton local news hub with events, breaking news and community coverage
- [Stockport News & Events](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/all-about/stockport): Stockport local news hub with breaking news, events and community information
- [Saddleworth & Lees News](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/all-about/saddleworth-and-lees): Saddleworth and Lees local news hub covering community updates and regional news

## Crime, Courts & Justice

- [Courts News](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/all-about/courts): Court news coverage from Manchester Crown Court and local magistrates courts

## Community & Workplace Issues

- [Employment News & Worker Rights](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/all-about/employment): Employment news coverage including minimum wage, workplace rights and regulations
